About

Come to dance.

Soft Serve is a London house music night run by Alex Brown (GAZZA) and Oscar Marriott-Clarke (OMC). Since October 2025 we have put on four nights across three London venues and sold 741 tickets.

The sound is house through and through: progressive, tech house, electronic, tribal and dubby. Sets mix vinyl and digital formats, and the music always comes first.

We promote an inclusive, fun and energetic party, and our lineups reflect that. The dance floor is full of dancers with no phones in sight, and the smoking area is friendly and chatty. New faces are made to feel welcome.
